title: Nokos, Green Seasoning Paste
author: Pierre Thiam (Lake Isle Press, ‘The Fonio Cookbook’)
desc: Bay leaves, jalapeños, green pepper, black peppercorns, a head of garlic and ginger blended to a thick, wet paste — Thiam’s pounded seasoning, not to be confused with the Wolof onion-and-nététou base nokoss.
longDesc: Thiam’s nokos goes into the marinade for his chicken yassa and other dishes. Two bay leaves, two green jalapeños or other chiles, a small green bell pepper, a quarter cup of whole black peppercorns, a head of peeled garlic and a tablespoon of grated ginger are combined in a blender and processed until a thick, wet paste forms. It makes 1 cup. The name is spelled ‘nokos’ by Thiam, ‘nokkos’ by Marie-Claude Mendy and Aissatou Ba and ‘nokoss’ in other printings; all three spellings are preserved. It is not the same preparation as nokoss (SEN012), the Wolof base of onion and nététou.
ingredients: 2 green jalapeño or other chiles, stemmed and chopped
1 small green bell pepper, stemmed, seeded and chopped
steps: Combine all the ingredients in a blender.
Process until a thick, wet paste forms.
chefTips: The printed cue is ‘until a thick, wet paste forms’ — no time or speed is given.
Makes 1 cup; the yassa recipe uses it by the tablespoon.
A pestle and mortar gives a coarser paste if you prefer.
commonMistakes: Adding water, which thins the paste.
Confusing it with nokoss (SEN012) — different ingredients, different use.
Leaving the bay leaves in whole pieces that will not blend.
storage: The page prints no storage time; refrigerate airtight.
healthBenefits: Garlic and ginger are traditional digestive seasonings.
culturalNote: Spelling is not settled across the research: Thiam ‘nokos’, Mendy ‘nokkos’ in the heading and ‘Nokoss’ in step 4, Ba ‘nokkos’. The three printings are not the same recipe.
sources: Source: Pierre Thiam, ‘The Fonio Cookbook’ (Lake Isle Press, 2019), via the Lake Isle Press post ‘Yassa, Indeed: Discovering a Classic Senegalese Dish’. Yield ‘Makes 1 cup’. SINGLE-PASS. Cue in direct quote: ‘until a thick, wet paste forms’. Time and temperature absent.
UNRECONCILED with SEN012 (nokoss: onion and nététou) and with Mendy’s nokkos in SEN093 (garlic, bell pepper, green onions, yellow onion, salt, pepper and cayenne).
